channel.title: Mastery Path — What's New
channel.description: Updates, new lessons and features across the Mastery Path network of 83 free courses.

item.title: New course: React Native Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on React Native with Expo and TypeScript, from first screen to store release: how React Native renders native views, core components, StyleSheet and Flexbox, Pressable, TextInput, FlatList, safe areas and platform differences, debugging, a habit tracker project, then navigation with Expo Router, params and deep links, Context and Zustand, TanStack Query, AsyncStorage, SecureStore and SQLite with migrations, forms with React Hook Form and Zod, images and fonts, the keyboard and modals, and an offline-friendly recipe book — then the New Architecture (JSI, Fabric, TurboModules), camera, location and haptics, permissions, notifications, Reanimated, Gesture Handler, accessibility, a native module with the Expo Modules API, development builds and config plugins, and an offline-sync field-notes app — and production: profiling, FlashList, Jest and React Native Testing Library, Maestro and Detox, mobile security, EAS Build and signing, store submission, OTA updates with fingerprints, Sentry monitoring, and a release-candidate capstone. Code was type-checked and tested with Jest in a real Expo SDK 57 project; device- and account-only steps are labelled as such.

item.title: New course: Ethical Hacking Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on ethical hacking taught strictly for authorized, lab-only use: what authorization, scope and the law require, building an isolated practice lab, the penetration-testing lifecycle, the Linux command line, networking for testers, passive OSINT, active scanning with Nmap, service enumeration, CVE and CVSS, then web application testing against deliberately vulnerable practice apps — the testing mindset and intercepting proxies, SQL injection, XSS, broken authentication and sessions, broken access control and IDOR, SSRF, file upload and path traversal, misconfiguration and vulnerable components, API security — then infrastructure testing in the lab: vulnerability scanning and validation, exploitation with Metasploit, password cracking, Linux and Windows privilege escalation, Active Directory attack paths, pivoting, wireless, and authorized phishing simulation — and the professional craft: post-exploitation ethics, report writing, scoping and rules of engagement, threat modeling, cloud and mobile basics, red team vs bug bounty, certifications and careers, the law and responsible disclosure, and a full end-to-end engagement capstone. Runnable demonstrations (SQL injection, output encoding, path traversal and password cracking) were verified locally; everything else is clearly labelled lab-only.

item.title: New course: Flutter Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on Flutter from first widget to shipped app: the engine and widget tree, the constraints layout model, stateful widgets and their lifecycle, forms, lists and keys, Material 3 theming, navigation and go_router, InheritedWidget, Provider, Riverpod and Bloc with measured rebuilds, async UI, a typed HTTP client, local persistence with migrations, unit, widget and golden tests, elements and BuildContext, implicit and explicit animations, CustomPainter, responsive layouts, platform channels, isolates, accessibility and localization, integration tests, an offline-first habit tracker, the rendering pipeline and a custom RenderObject, performance, layered architecture, flavors and --dart-define, CI, store publishing, JS and Wasm web builds, plugins and dart:ffi, upgrades, and a production-ready expense tracker capstone. Examples were verified with real test runs on Flutter 3.44.

item.title: New course: GraphQL Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on GraphQL from first schema to federated graph: the type system, queries, resolvers, mutations, Apollo Server over HTTP, errors and null propagation, client-driven schema design, interfaces and unions, custom scalars, the N+1 problem measured and fixed with DataLoader, cursor pagination, mutation payloads, testing, JWT authentication, authorization on every path, schema directives, subscriptions over WebSockets, query cost limits, caching and persisted queries, Apollo Client's normalized cache, code generation, graphql-js internals, tracing, Apollo Federation with real query plans, schema evolution, error masking, code-first schemas, graphql-js 17 and a federated storefront capstone. Every example was run on Node.js 26 with graphql 16.

item.title: New course: FastAPI Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on FastAPI from first endpoint to production: ASGI and the request lifecycle, path and query parameters, Pydantic v2 request and response models, error handling, forms and uploads, routers, dependency injection and yield-dependency teardown, async vs sync measured under load, SQLAlchemy 2.x sync and async, N+1 queries, Alembic, pydantic-settings, isolated database tests, pagination, Argon2 password hashing, OAuth2 and JWT with rotating refresh tokens, scopes and object-level authorization, middleware and CORS, lifespan and background tasks, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events, OpenAPI and generated clients, caching, ETags and rate limits, profiling, workers and graceful shutdown, reverse proxies, structured logs, metrics and built-in OpenTelemetry, OWASP API hardening, versioning, job queues, upgrades, and a booking API that never overbooks across four worker processes, with outputs checked against real runs.

item.title: New course: Django Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on Django 6 from first view to production: the request/response cycle, URLs and views, templates and autoescaping, models and migrations, the ORM, admin, forms and CSRF, static and media files, relationships, Q/F/annotate, finding N+1 queries, class-based views, authentication, permissions, the custom user model, middleware, testing, Django REST Framework serializers, viewsets, API auth and throttling, signals, transactions and race conditions, zero-downtime migrations, caching, the Tasks framework and Celery, async Django, security, production settings, deployment with Gunicorn/Uvicorn and PostgreSQL, query performance, management commands, template partials, logging, i18n and time zones, and upgrading, with outputs checked against real Django runs.

item.title: New course: Tailwind CSS Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on Tailwind CSS v4 from first utility to production: what the compiler generates, installation and source detection, spacing, typography, colour, Flexbox and Grid, state variants with group and peer, responsive breakpoints, @theme design tokens, dark mode, arbitrary values, @apply and @utility, aria/data/has variants, container queries, forms, motion, cascade layers and Preflight, custom utilities and plugins, accessibility with measured contrast, the Typography plugin, tailwind-merge and cva, design systems, v3 to v4 migration, production performance, linting, multi-brand theming, RTL, media variants, legacy CSS, server templates, debugging and Playwright testing, with compiled output and measurements taken in real browsers.

item.title: New course: HTML & CSS Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on HTML and CSS from first page to production: how browsers render, document structure, semantic text, images, tables, forms, selectors, the cascade and box model, typography, colour and contrast, Flexbox and Grid in depth, positioning and stacking contexts, responsive design, custom properties, the accessibility tree, landmarks, keyboard and focus, ARIA, accessible forms, container queries, :has(), nesting, cascade layers, motion, dialog and popover, rendering and loading performance, CSS architecture, design tokens, RTL and i18n, metadata and structured data, print, progressive enhancement and automated testing, with examples checked in real browsers.

item.title: New course: Vue.js Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on Vue 3.5 with the Composition API: templates and directives, ref, reactive and computed, watchers, props and emits, v-model, slots, composables, provide/inject, Vue Router 5, Pinia 4, async data, form validation, TypeScript, reactivity and rendering internals, directives and plugins, code splitting, performance, Vitest testing, accessibility, security, SSR from scratch, Nuxt 4, production builds, component libraries, architecture, Vue 2 migration, i18n, deployment and observability, with code verified against real builds.

item.title: New course: Angular Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on modern Angular 22: standalone components, signals, template control flow, services and dependency injection, routing, HttpClient, reactive and signal forms, RxJS interop, resource and httpResource, guards, interceptors, zoneless change detection, @defer, performance, SSR and hydration, Vitest testing, accessibility with @angular/aria, security, i18n, libraries, Angular Elements, migrations, deployment and observability, with code verified against real builds.

item.title: New course: Next.js Mastery Path
item.description: A 40-lesson course on Next.js 16 with the App Router: file-based routing and layouts, Server and Client Components, data fetching, dynamic routes, loading and error UI, Server Actions and forms, caching with and without Cache Components, Route Handlers, Proxy, authentication, Drizzle with SQLite, streaming, parallel and intercepting routes, i18n, SEO, Core Web Vitals, Vitest and Playwright, security and CSP, self-hosted deployment, observability, upgrades and accessibility, with code verified against a real build.

item.title: New course: AI Agents Mastery Path
item.description: A vendor-neutral course on building AI agents in 40 lessons: the agent loop written from scratch in plain Python, tool calling and tool design, error handling, stopping conditions, tracing, frameworks and state graphs, memory, ReAct and plan-and-execute, reflection, retrieval as a tool, human approvals, streaming, multi-agent supervisors and handoffs, MCP, sandboxing, task and trajectory evals, cost, reliability, prompt-injection defense, least privilege, policy as code, testing, ethics and rollout, with runnable offline code throughout.

item.title: New course: Prompt Engineering Mastery Path
item.description: A vendor-neutral prompt engineering course in 40 lessons: how models read prompts, clarity, context, few-shot examples, output formats, reasoning prompts, chaining, JSON output, system prompts, extraction and summarization, test sets and rubrics, LLM-as-judge biases, A/B tests, prompt-injection defense, guardrails, tool calling, long context, versioning, regression tests, cost, agents and ethics, with a runnable offline eval harness.

item.title: New course: Power BI Mastery Path
item.description: A Power BI course in 40 lessons: Power Query, data types and cleaning, star schemas, relationships, DAX with CALCULATE and context transition, time intelligence, row-level security, VertiPaq performance, calculation groups, field parameters, Fabric, governance, PBIP and Git, accessibility and model testing, with every DAX result checked against hand-computed sample data.

item.title: New course: Spring Boot Mastery Path
item.description: A Spring Boot backend course for Java developers: 40 lessons from dependency injection, REST controllers, validation and ProblemDetail errors through Spring Data JPA, Flyway, testing and JWT security, to auto-configuration and proxy internals, Kafka, resilience, observability, containers and deployment, with three projects and a capstone.

item.title: New course: Node.js Mastery Path
item.description: A Node.js runtime and backend course: 40 lessons from V8, libuv and ES modules through Express 5 APIs with PostgreSQL, auth and tests, to the event loop, streams, workers, WebSockets, profiling, observability and graceful shutdown, with a CLI, REST API, real-time chat and capstone.

item.title: New course: System Design Mastery Path
item.description: A system design course: 40 lessons on estimation, caching, replication, sharding, consensus, sagas, idempotency and reliability, with URL shortener, news feed and chat projects, case studies and a design-doc capstone.

item.title: New course: DSA & Coding Interviews Mastery Path
item.description: A data structures, algorithms and coding interview course: 40 lessons with tested Python solutions, from Big-O and hashing through graphs, DP and segment trees to mock interviews, online assessments and study plans.

item.title: New course: React Mastery Path
item.description: A hooks-first React course: 40 lessons across four levels, from a first Vite component to Server Components, concurrent rendering, security and large-app architecture, with a project closing each level.

item.title: Cross-site search and lesson progress tracking added network-wide
item.description: A fuzzy search bar on the hub now searches all 2,565 lessons across every course at once. Every one of the 64 sites also got lesson-completion checkboxes and a per-level progress bar, saved locally in your browser — no account needed.

item.title: YouTube video walkthroughs embedded across the network
item.description: Matching video walkthroughs from the Mastery Path YouTube channel are now embedded directly on 99+ lesson pages across python, javascript, shell, typescript, sql, c, java, cpp, go, ruby, php and rust.

item.title: Full Level 2-4 content backfilled on 7 course sites
item.description: ai-ml, docker, github, kubernetes, llm-dev, terraform and workday now have complete Level 2 through Level 4 content — real, mechanism-level lessons in place of every remaining placeholder page.

item.title: "How It Actually Works" sections added to every real lesson, network-wide
item.description: Every existing topic module across all 64 sites now includes a dedicated section explaining the underlying mechanism — not just how to use a feature, but why it behaves the way it does.

item.title: Content license published: CC BY 4.0 for lessons, MIT for code
item.description: All written lessons across the network are licensed CC BY 4.0, and every code snippet is additionally released under the MIT License — free to share, adapt and reuse.

item.title: Mastery Path hub page launched
item.description: A real hub page replaced the old redirect stub — a categorized directory of all 64 free courses, in one place.
